text: また　たべすぎちゃった　はらごなしに　しょうぶ　しよ！

structure.jp: また　たべすぎちゃった

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a verb says it is done too much. たべすぎちゃった = 'I ate too much'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう says the thing ended up happening, to your regret. ちゃった is its casual short form. たべすぎちゃった = 'I went and overate'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に here says what something is done for. はらごなしに = 'as a way to digest my meal'.
